description: Get per-episode download counts for a show from OP3: for each recent episode, downloads in the first 1/3/7/30 days after publish and all-time. Good for comparing how episodes perform. Needs a show UUID. Use limit to cap how many episodes come back.

limit.description: Max episodes to return, newest first (default 10).

sort_by.description: Order results: recent (default), all-time downloads, or 7-day downloads.

name: op3_episode_downloads
